title: Page action:menu, action:group and action:icon render a non-string label raw: action:menu white-screens on a locale-map label (the #36717 family beyond action:button)
body: repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D Filing gate: ① a product defect with named locations (one card for one family) · Source: fleet (L1 record 7157997155 on PR #37262 / card #36717's family; the seat repo:objectstack#4 asked that it be filed as one follow-up card) ## What happens Ruling A on #36717 (7118756694, the maintainer's 「保持走翻译包」) keeps every page action component's `label` a `z.string()`, localized through the translation bundle key for its component id. PR #37262 guards `action:button` so that a non-string label (for example a locale map from code-registered metadata that skipped `validateComponentProps`) renders no text instead of throwing. The sibling page action components still read `schema.label` raw. At `origin/main` 9171bed0: - `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-menu.tsx`: `{schema.label && {schema.label}}` (~414), `aria-label={schema.label || …}` (~404), the icon spacing (~413) and the diagnostic label (~246). The L1 probe measured that `action:menu` with a locale-map label throws "Objects are not valid as a React child", which white-screens the page. - `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-group.tsx`: `{schema.label || 'Actions'}` (~451) and the diagnostic label (~314). - `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx`: `schema.label?.charAt(0)` (~314; a locale map has no `charAt`, so it throws), `aria-label` (~301), the runner forward (~175) and the diagnostic label (~112). reach: L1 probe measurement for `action:menu`; read from code for the other two. Reached by any page whose metadata skipped validation and carries a non-string label on these nodes. ## Expected The same render guard as `action:button` (PR #37262), per ruling A: - never throw on a non-string label; - render no text (or the fallback each component already has); - log one development warning per component; - never translate the map, and never print `[object Object]`. - A string label renders and translates exactly as today. Reuse PR #37262's `renderableLabel` if it can be shared, rather than a third copy. ## Acceptance - One pin per site (menu, group, icon), each as a top-level `describe` in that component's existing harness. An object label renders without crashing and shows no `[object Object]`; a string-label control and a bundle-key translation control stay green. - Ablate once per site. - `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; one `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/components`. Blocked-by: #37262 Grading: area:ux · Bug · moderate (a page white-screens on an invalid but unvalidated label) · reach: measured for `action:menu` by the L1 probe · evidence measured or read → p2, size S; triage to confirm. Business reason: a code-registered page with a localized menu or icon action crashes the whole page instead of drawing the action without text, exactly as #36717 was for buttons. Reader: zone a4-U, after PR #37262 lands, which provides the shared guard. Dedupe: `action-menu label locale` (open) → 6 hits, none on this; #36717 (the button half, PR #37262) is the parent.
